key_layers.name: Controller
key_layers.responsibility: HTTP handlers, split into admin/ auth/ sdk/

key_layers.name: Security
key_layers.responsibility: Two filter chains: JWT admin auth + API-key SDK auth

external_deps.purpose: Primary datastore, schema owned by Liquibase

gotchas: FeatureFlag.key is immutable — set at creation, never updated; FeatureFlagServiceImpl.update() intentionally ignores it
FlagEnvironmentState is auto-created per environment on FeatureFlag creation — never query flags without joining this table
Two separate SecurityFilterChain beans: SDK chain (order=1, X-Environment-Key header) and Admin chain (order=2, JWT Bearer) — order matters
PermissionService (not controllers) enforces OrganizationMember.role checks before mutations
test_isolation: Uses H2 for tests; PostgreSQL via docker-compose for local/integration runs
sensitive_areas: security/ and JWT config — two-filter-chain auth design
src/main/resources/db/changelog/migrations/ — never modify an already-run changeset, always add a new one

conventions.formatter: none — no linter/formatter detected, follow existing code style by convention
